events.name: League Championship
events.description: Face the region's top trainers in a final authored gauntlet once you have enough crests.
events.introText: The championship committee is ready. Defeat each trainer in order to claim the title.
events.completionText: The crowd erupts as your championship clear is recorded in the league ledger.

reward.text: League officials hand over the championship purse.

events.name: Winter Classic
events.description: An elimination tournament with a curated trainer field and a frosty ruleset.
events.introText: Registration is open. Once you enter, your current party is locked until the bracket is over.
events.completionText: You lift the Winter Classic trophy after surviving the bracket.

reward.text: Tournament staff award your winnings and mark your name in the event record.
